project.name: Inspecto - Regulatory Reporting (optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL add-on module (REGULATORY-REPORTING-1, 2026-10-09): regulator-format reports (a SAR / STR is the motivating case) assembled from a Case or Incident, its member Incidents and its evidence (attachment notes), rendered from a Report Template to XML, CSV or JSON, approved four-eyes, then submitted to a file-drop folder. The routes (/regulatory-reports*), the store (a signed JSON file per report under regulatory-reports/ in the write root - NOT an operational-store family), the renderer and the file drop. Package com.gamma.regreporting.
Contributed through com.gamma.spi.http.RouteModule only (feature id "regulatoryReporting"). It REQUIRES inspecto-ops (it reads Cases, Incidents, links and notes through ObjectService and applies ObjectRoutes' scope guard, as inspecto-case-management does); the approver roster, approver check and the Pending Change key it signs with stay in the core.
Bundled from the Professional edition up (the Standard, Professional, Enterprise and Preview profiles). THIN: no shade, no sidecar classifier. Built only under the edition profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal) never compiles it.
